{Black has misplayed the Fajarowicz variation. How can White win material?} 7.
Qd5 {[%wrong There's a better option. Try again and look for a strong fork.] 
[%hint Attack c5 and e4 with your queen.]} (7. Qd3 $2 Ng5 {White is only
slightly better. Try again and look for a stronger threat.}) (7. Qc2 $2 Ng5 {
White is only slightly better. Try again and look for a winning fork.}) (7. b4
$2 axb4 {Black wins a pawn. Try again and look for a better way to attack the
c5-bishop.}) 7... f5 {Good move! What's the best way to get ahead?} 8. exf6 {
[%wrong There's a better option. Try again and check the hint if you're
feeling stuck.] [%hint Remember about en passant!]} (8. Nbd2 $2 Ne7 {White has
only a small advantage. Try again and check the hint if you're stuck.}) (8. Bd3
$2 Ne7 {The white queen is trapped. Try again and look for a stronger forcing
move.}) 8... Nxf6 {Nice move! What's next?} 9. Qxc5 {[%wrong There's a better
move. Try again and look for a strong capture.] [%hint Capture an undefended
piece.] Great job! White wins a bishop and should win the game.} *

{How should Black play against White's greedy queen move?} 4... d6 {[%wrong
White is better. Try again and look for a good move to defend your knight.] 
[%hint Release a bishop to defend your knight on g4.]} (4... Bb4+ $5 5. Bd2 {
If you were planning the exciting Qg5 next, good work! There's another strong
option as well. Try to find it.}) (4... Nh6 $2 5. Nf3 {The knight is poorly
placed on h6 and White is doing well. Try to find a move to help you develop
and defend the knight.}) (4... Qh4 $2 5. h3 {White will use the pin on the
fourth rank to win material. Try to find a better way to defend your knight.})
5. exd6 {Good move. How should you recapture on d6?} Bxd6 {[%wrong There's a
better move. Try again and look for a good capture.] [%hint Capture and
develop a piece.]} (5... Nc6 $5 {That's just as good as our main line. Well
done! Can you also find a good way to capture on d6?}) (5... Qxd6 $2 6. Qxd6 {
Typically you don't want to trade when you're down a pawn. Try again.}) (5...
cxd6 $2 6. Nc3 {White is better. Try again.}) 6. Qxg7 {Black was doing well
anyway, but White's last move was a big mistake. How can Black win material?}
Be5 {[%wrong White is winning. Try again.] [%hint Find the best way to attack
the white queen.]} (6... Qf6 $2 7. Qxf6 {White is doing well after the trade
of queens. Try to find a better way to attack the white queen.}) 7. Qg5 {
Nice move! What should you capture?} Qxg5 {[%wrong There's a stronger move.
Try again and look for a winning capture.] [%hint Trade queens to decoy the
defender of the b2-pawn.]} (7... Bf6 $2 8. Qb5+ {White is OK. Try again and
look for a good capture.}) (7... Bxb2 $2 8. Qxd8+ {White will capture on b2
next and Black is in trouble. Try again and look for a stronger capture.}) 8.
Bxg5 {Good choice! What can you capture next?} Bxb2 {[%wrong There's a much
stronger option. Try to find the best capture.] [%hint Capture an undefended
pawn.] Well done! White has no way to save the a1-rook and Black is winning.} (
8... Nxh2 $2 9. Nc3 {White is doing well. Try again and look for a stronger
capture.}) (8... Bxh2 $2 9. g3 {White is doing well. Try again and look for a
stronger capture.}) 1-0

{White has sacrificed a pawn but has a way to win it back with interest. What
should you play?} 14. Bxf7+ {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and
check the hint if you're stuck.] [%hint Sacrifice a piece to lure the black
king into danger.]} (14. Qd5 $2 Qe8 {Black keeps a material edge. Try again
and check the hint if you're stuck.}) (14. Qh5 $2 Re7 {Black is up material.
Try again and check the hint if you're stuck.}) 14... Kxf7 {Awesome move! How
can you win the e4-rook?} 15. Qf3+ {[%wrong There's a stronger attacking move.
Try again and look for a winning fork.] [%hint Find the best way to fork
Black's king and rook.]} (15. Qd5+ $2 Re6 {Black escapes with a material edge.
Try again and look for a better check.}) (15. Qh5+ $2 Kg8 {Black can meet Qd5+
next with Re6 and keep a material edge. Try again and look for a better check.}
) 15... Kg8 {Almost there. What's next?} 16. Qxe4 {[%wrong There's a stronger
move. Try again and look for a good capture.] [%hint Capture an undefended
piece.] Nice work! White has an extra exchange and a great position.} *

{How should Black activate the a8-rook as quickly as possible?} 11... Ra6 {
[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a way to quickly bring
your a8-rook to the kingside.] [%hint Lift your a8-rook to take advantage of
the open sixth rank.]} (11... d6 $5 {This is OK, but putting a pawn on the
sixth rank makes it harder to include the a8-rook in your attack. Try to find
a way to activate that rook as quickly as possible.}) (11... Qh4 $5 {This is
reasonable, but let's try to activate the a8-rook as quickly as possible.}) (
11... b6 $5 {This is OK, but putting a pawn on the sixth rank makes it harder
to include the a8-rook in your attack. Try to find a way to activate that rook
as quickly as possible.}) 12. Nc3 {Good start! Where can that rook head next
to launch a kingside attack?} Rh6 {[%wrong There's a better option. Try to
find the ideal square for your queenside rook.] [%hint Bring a rook to the
h-file.]} (12... Rg6 $5 {This is a good move, but let's move the rook one more
square to help launch the atttack.}) (12... Qh4 $5 {This is reasonable, but
let's find a way to include the a6-rook in the attack before the queen.}) (
12... d6 $5 {This is playable, but a pawn on the sixth rank makes it difficult
to activate the a6-rook. Try to find a useful move with that rook to prepare a
kingside attack.}) (12... b6 $2 13. Nd5 {A pawn on the sixth rank makes it
difficult to activate the a6-rook. Try to find a useful move with that rook to
prepare a kingside attack.}) (12... Rd6 $2 13. Qc2 {The rook on d6 makes it
difficult to develop the c8-bishop. Try to find a stronger rook move.}) 13. Nd5
{Good choice! How should Black prepare to develop another piece?} d6 {[%wrong
There's a better developing move. Try to find it.] [%hint Release your
c8-bishop so it can develop.] Well played! We will continue the attack in the
next challenge.} (13... Qh4 $5 {This is reasonable, but it's stronger to
develop the c8-bishop. How should you do it?}) (13... c6 $5 {This is
reasonable, but it's stronger to develop the c8-bishop. How should you do it?})
(13... b6 $2 14. b4 {White forces the c5-bishop to retreat and takes the
initiative. Try again and look for a better way to develop the c8-bishop.}) *

{White has attacked the c5-bishop, but there's no need to move it. How should
Black continue the kingside attack?} 14... Qh4 {[%wrong There's a stronger
attacking move. Try to find a way to threaten checkmate.] [%hint Develop your
queen to threaten mate.]} (14... Ba7 $2 15. f4 {White chases away the
centralized knight, with chances to defend successfully. Try again and look for
a way the threaten checkmate.}) (14... axb4 $2 15. f4 {White chases away the
centralized knight, with chances to defend successfully. Try again and look for
a way the threaten checkmate.}) (14... Bb6 $2 15. f4 {White chases away the
centralized knight, with an OK game. Try again and look for a way to threaten
checkmate.}) 15. h3 {Good choice! How should you break open the white kingside?
} Bxh3 {[%wrong There's a better attacking move. Try to find a good capture.] 
[%hint Sacrifice a piece to expose the white king.]} (15... axb4 $2 16. Bxe5 {
Black is doing well, but there's a much stronger capture. Try to find it.}) (
15... Bb6 $2 16. Nxb6 {Black is doing well, but there's a much stronger move.
Try to find a good capture.}) (15... Ba7 $2 16. Nf4 {White defends the
kingside with an OK position. Try again and look for a good capture.}) (15...
Rg6 $2 16. Nf4 {White defends every weakness and will soon win material. Try
again and look for a good capture.}) 16. gxh3 {In the game Paasikangas -
Maidla 1993, White tried g2-g3, but only briefly delayed checkmate. How would
Black continue the attack after gxh3?} Qxh3 {[%wrong There's a better move.
Try again and look for a strong capture.] [%hint Capture a pawn and threaten
mate.] Great work! White has no good way to prevent checkmate.} (16... Bxe3 $5
{Black is winning, but another capture is even stronger. Try to find it.}) (
16... Rg6+ $2 17. Kh2 {White has good chances to defend. Try again and look
for a strong capture.}) *

{How should Black save the e5-knight?} 5... Nec6 {[%wrong White will win
material. Try again and look for a good way to save your e5-knight.] [%hint
Retreat your knight to the queenside.]} (5... Ng6 $2 6. h4 {Black's knight
will soon be chased again and White is doing well. Try again and look for a
safer knight move.}) (5... Bc5 $2 6. fxe5 {After Qh4+ and Kd2 Black doesn't
have enough compensation for the lost material. Try again and look for a safe
knight move.}) (5... Qh4+ $2 6. g3 {The queen must retreat. Try again and look
for a stronger check.}) (5... Bb4+ $2 6. Bd2 {White doesn't mind the exchange
of bishops. Try again and look for a good knight move.}) 6. Be3 {Good start!
How should you continue to develop?} Bb4+ {[%wrong There's a better option.
Try to find the best way to develop your kingside.] [%hint Develop your bishop
with check.] Well played! Black will soon castle with a safe position.} (6...
Qh4+ $2 7. g3 {The queen must retreat again. Try again and look for a stronger
check.}) (6... Na6 $2 7. a3 {It will be difficult to centralize the a6-knight.
Try again and look for a way to develop a bishop.}) (6... Be7 $2 7. Nc3 {
There's a more active square for the bishop. Try to find it.}) (6... Bd6 $2 7.
c5 {White forces the bishop to a passive square. Try again and look for a
better bishop move.}) *

{White has accepted doubled pawns but is still one pawn ahead. How should you
prevent Black from winning it back?} 8. Qd5 {[%wrong Black will win material
with a good position. Try again and look for a good way to defend the e5-pawn.]
[%hint Centralize your queen and defend the e5-pawn.] Nice move! Black has no
way to win back the e5-pawn. We will examine Black's best way to demonstrate
compensation in the next challenge.} (8. g3 $2 Ngxe5 {Black wins back the pawn
with a safe position. Try again and look for a good way to defend the e5-pawn.}
) (8. Qd4 $2 Nxd4 {Black wins the queen. Try to find a stronger queen move to
defend e5.}) (8. e6 $2 dxe6 {Black wins back the pawn and defends c7. Try
again and look for a good way to defend your e5-pawn.}) *

{Black can't win back the e5-pawn but can gain decent compensation by trading
for it. What should you play?} 8... f6 {[%wrong There's a stronger move. Try
again and look for a way to trade for the e5-pawn.] [%hint Trade your f-pawn
for the e5-pawn.]} (8... Qa3 $5 {This is reasonable, but there's a better
option. Try to find a good move to trade off the e5-pawn.}) (8... O-O $2 9. h3
{The g4-knight must retreat to the passive h6-square. Try again and look for a
way to trade for the e5-pawn.}) (8... d6 $2 9. exd6 {White wins material. Try
to find a better pawn move to attack e5.}) (8... b6 $2 9. h3 {The g4-knight
must retreat to the passive h6-square. Try again and look for a way to trade
for the e5-pawn.}) 9. exf6 {Good start! How should you recapture on f6?} Nxf6 {
[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a good capture.] [%hint
Recapture and attack the white queen.] Good idea! White's queen must retreat
and Black gains an initiative to compensate for White's extra pawn.} (9... Qxf6
$2 10. Qe4+ {Black doesn't have enough compensation for the sacrificed pawn.
Try again and look for a better capture.}) (9... gxf6 10. Qh5+ {White wins the
g4-knight. Try again and look for a stronger capture.}) *

{How did GM Gligoric gain a big positional advantage with the white pieces?} 
12. c5 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find the best way to offer an
exchange of queens.] [%hint Advance a pawn to offer a queen trade.]} (12. Qd1
$5 {This is reasonable, but the best move offers an exchange of queens. How
should you do it?}) (12. Be2 $5 {This is reasonable, but the best move offers
an exchange of queens. How should you do it?}) (12. Bg3 $5 {This is reasonable,
but the best move offers an exchange of queens. How should you do it?}) (12.
Bd3 $2 Nge7 {White loses significant time saving the queen. Try to find a
stronger option to offer an exchange of queens right away.}) (12. Qd2 $2 Qxd2+
{There's a much better move to offer a trade of queens. Try to find it and
check the hint if you're stuck.}) 12... Qxd5 {Great move! In Gligoric
Westerinen 1971 Black tried Qa3 but soon lost. What's next after Qxd5?} 13.
exd5 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a good capture.] 
[%hint Recapture the queen.] Well played! White's massive pawn center and lead
in development guarantee a big advantage.} *
